    DisplayHint
    How an indicator's value should be presented — the typed view of the IndicatorMeta.DISPLAY metadata entry.
    FundingRateValueSource
    FundingRate enumeration of value sources, aligned with XChange's FundingRateInterval.
    IndicatorMeta
    Descriptive metadata an indicator carries about itself, kept separate from its registered name .
    IndicatorNotice
    A Notice an indicator group raises about its own wiring: it names the indicator concerned and the instrument whose group raised it, which is what makes a notice actionable when a strategy runs the same indicator set across many instruments.

    What makes a notice unique: the condition, and the indicator it concerns.
    KlineValueSource
    Value sources available on a kline (bar): the OHLCV fields shared with every market snapshot plus the kline-only trade count.
    MarketSnapshotValueSource
    Common supertype for the scalar field selectors of the sealed market snapshot hierarchy: TickerValueSource (ticker fields incl. bid/ask/vwap) and KlineValueSource (kline OHLCV + trade stats).

    Interface for a Real Time Indicator.
